'''Fleet Command''', also known as '''New Republic Fleet Command''' and '''Fleet Office'''<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref> was the command staff for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|Defense Fleet]]. It was stationed in a large chamber on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that resembled a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] [[galaxarium]]. It was possibly related to the [[Admiralty (New Republic)|Admiralty]]. It was most likely [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force Fleet Command|reorganized]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
